title: 第一卷 第10章 长老惜才，暗藏算计
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
院门之外，立着一名白衣内门弟子。

    气质温润，灵气内敛，气息远胜外门所有弟子。

    这是宗门专门负责接引、传令的内门侍者。

    寻常外门弟子，一辈子都未必能让内门弟子亲自登门传唤。

    苏玄尘起身，整理衣衫，从容出门。

    “有劳师兄带路。”

    他态度谦和，不卑不亢。

    白衣弟子微微颔首，目光带着几分好奇打量他。

    眼前老者白发苍苍、身形佝偻，看着风烛残年。

    可他感应之下，对方体内灵力精纯凝练，远超普通外门弟子。

    尤其是那隐隐透出的灵根气息，纯净到极致，令人心惊。

    “难怪长老亲自召见，确实非同凡响。”

    白衣弟子心中暗叹，不再多言，转身引路。

    两人穿行山间石阶，一路穿过外门区域，走向内门山峰。

    沿途路过的弟子，纷纷驻足侧目，满脸震惊。

    谁也没想到，这位百岁老者，竟然能让内门弟子亲自接引！

    一路上行，灵气愈发浓郁。

    内外门天地，判若云泥。

    不多时，抵达一座清雅幽静的悬山阁楼——【清议阁】。

    这里是青玄宗长老日常议事、接见弟子之地。

    阁楼之内，端坐一名青袍中年修士。

    面容儒雅，双目深邃，周身灵气厚重如海。

    正是青玄宗执法长老，炼气巅峰、半步筑基的大能——柳长老。

    白衣弟子躬身退下，关好阁门。

    阁楼之内，只剩苏玄尘与柳长老二人。

    柳长老目光温和，细细打量眼前百岁老者。

    眼中有惋惜，有欣赏，也有一丝不易察觉的算计。

    “坐。”
content_en:
Outside the courtyard gate, stood an inner disciple in white.

    His temperament is gentle, his aura is restrained, and his aura is far superior to that of all the disciples of the outer sect.

    This is the inner waiter of the sect who is responsible for receiving guidance and delivering orders.

    Ordinary outer sect disciples may not be able to have inner sect disciples come and summon them in person in their lifetime.

    Su Xuanchen stood up, tidied his clothes, and went out calmly.

    "Senior Brother, please lead the way."

    He has a humble attitude, neither humble nor arrogant.

    The disciple in white nodded slightly and looked at him with a bit of curiosity.

    The old man in front of him has gray hair and a stooped figure, and looks like he is dying in his old age.

    But under his induction, the spiritual power in the opponent's body was pure and condensed, far exceeding that of ordinary outer disciples.

    Especially the faint aura of spiritual roots, which is extremely pure and frightening.

    "No wonder it's really extraordinary that the elder summoned him personally."

    The disciple in white sighed secretly, said no more, turned around and led the way.

    The two walked through the stone steps in the mountains, passing through the outer gate area and heading towards the inner gate peak.

    The disciples passing by along the way stopped and looked sideways, with shock on their faces.

    No one expected that this hundred-year-old man could actually be guided by the inner disciples in person!

    Along the way, the spiritual energy becomes more and more intense.

    The world between the inner and outer gates is as different as clouds and mud.

    Not long after, we arrived at an elegant and quiet attic hanging on a mountain - [Qingyi Pavilion].

    This is the place where the elders of Qingxuan Sect hold daily discussions and receive disciples.

    In the attic, a middle-aged monk in green robes sat.

    His face is elegant, his eyes are deep, and his spiritual energy is as thick as the sea.

    It was Elder Liu, the law enforcement elder of Qingxuan Sect, a master at the peak of Qi refining and a half-step foundation builder.

    The disciple in white bowed and retreated, closing the door of the pavilion.

    In the attic, only Su Xuanchen and Elder Liu were left.

    Elder Liu's eyes were gentle and he carefully looked at the hundred-year-old man in front of him.

    There was regret, appreciation, and a subtle calculation in his eyes.

    "sit."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 10 Elders cherish talents and hide their plans
